text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- IMF head Michael Camdessus said in Skopje on Sunday that Macedonia has serious problems with unemployment and needs foreign help. He praised Macedonian legal regulations which allow for easier foreign investments in the country.
- International military exercises Rescuer '97 start Monday in Macedonia. The five-day exercise will group 12 countries, 963 people of whom 664 professional soldiers.
- Austrian Parliament Speaker Hans Fischer said in Skopje Austria would continue to support Macedonia in its European integration efforts. He said Austria was interested in investing in Macedonia.

- Albanian Defence Minister Shakir Vukai arrived in Macedonia on Sunday to take part in military exercises. Macedonian Defence Minister Blagoja Handziski stressed Macedonia's interest in stabilisation in Albania.

- Association of Macedonian Journalists organised a debate on the topic "Attack on Journalists, Attack on Democracy". The journalists demand protection from state institutions against frequent physical attacks.

- Depositors in bankrupt pyramid financial institution Makedonija-Reklam vow civil disobedience and participation in a protest rally scheduled on May 15 by the opposition party IMRO-DPMNY. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
